input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: The exception-message predicate requires the regular expression to match the entire exception message.
- failure path: Given an exception message with a matching prefix followed by additional diagnostic text, the retry condition returns false and Tenacity propagates the exception without retrying.

Reviewer finding
- description: The match check changed from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch (whole-string match), which the commit title does not announce.
- rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match='foo') on an exception whose str is 'foo bar'. Before this change, match() returned a truthy result and the exception was retried. After it, fullmatch() returns None, so the exception is no longer retried. Impact: existing users who rely on prefix-style regex matching silently lose retries on those exceptions, with no error raised.
critique: The finding says the exception-message predicate uses fullmatch, so the regex must match the whole message. A message with a matching prefix plus extra text therefore fails the check and is not retried. This is the same mechanism and failure path as the label.
